objective: Test whether JANUS can switch an exact future-interface from ROBDD to d-DNNF and preserve projected Boolean semantics under authorized ASSIGN transitions with replayable translation certificates and explicit translation/verification cost.
scope_boundary: R2D tests switch correctness, not succinctness advantage. R2E remains cumulative switching-cost attack.

languages.destination: d-DNNF produced by structural Shannon translation

translation_rule: Each ROBDD node (v,lo,hi) becomes OR(AND(NOT(v),T(lo)),AND(v,T(hi))). Terminals map to constants. Shared ROBDD nodes remain shared destination DAG nodes.
local_certificate_obligations: DETERMINISM: the two OR branches contain complementary v guards and are mutually exclusive
DECOMPOSABILITY: v is absent from the support of both translated child subcircuits because ROBDD children respect the remaining variable suffix
SHARING: identical source node ids map to one destination node id
TERMINAL_PRESERVATION: source 0/1 map to destination false/true

frozen_corpus.source_order_policy: R2C selector policy, family label hidden

cross_language_congruence: For every state/action, condition translated d-DNNF and compare against the exact CNF successor semantics. Exhaustive remaining-variable assignments are used in the bounded R2D universe.

cost_accounting.translation: source/destination DAG nodes and constructed connective count
cost_accounting.verification: local certificate checks plus exhaustive semantic evaluations
cost_accounting.rule: translation or verification work is never zero merely because source/destination are equivalent by construction

gates.G1_TRANSLATION_LOCAL_CERT: all translated internal nodes satisfy frozen determinism/decomposability/support checks
gates.G2_IDENTITY_SEMANTICS: translated d-DNNF matches source CNF on every assignment in frozen corpus
gates.G3_ASSIGN_CONGRUENCE: for every variable/value action, conditioned d-DNNF matches exact restricted CNF on every remaining assignment
gates.G4_LINEAR_TRANSLATION_SIGNATURE: destination structural node/connective count <= 5 * source ROBDD total nodes on every case
gates.G5_COST_ACCOUNTING: translation and semantic verification work are explicitly nonzero
gates.G6_NO_AUTHORITY_PROMOTION: finite congruence survivor is not a universal cross-language theorem and P_VS_NP remains OPEN

journal_rule: Store every case, first local-certificate failure, first semantic mismatch with action/assignment, source/destination sizes, verification work and next R2E frontier append-only.
